visual_action: A montage of scenic American landscapes. The clips include: an American flag waving in a desert landscape that appears to be Monument Valley, a rustic log cabin in a grassy field with the Teton Range in the background, misty green mountains, a view of Half Dome in Yosemite National Park, a large red rock butte in the desert, a wide green valley with trees and mountains, giant sequoia trees at night against a starry sky, and an aerial view of vehicles driving on a dirt road through a desert canyon.
